relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Dysregulation of calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) and substance P exacerbates post-traumatic headache through trigeminovascular sensitization.

key_findings: Review: neuroinflammation and central sensitization sustain chronic post-TBI pain.
CGRP antagonists, A3AR agonists, GABAergic modulators, PEA and myrcene show promise.
